deck.title: Sustainable Management of Rocks, Ores & Minerals

front_blocks.md: Define **finite resource**.

back_blocks.md: A **finite resource** is a natural resource that people use up **faster than it is replaced**.

cards.front_md: Define **finite resource**.
cards.back_md: A **finite resource** is a natural resource that people use up **faster than it is replaced**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Fossil fuels, minerals and metals are all examples of finite resources.

back_blocks.md: **True.**
They exist in **limited amounts** and **cannot be replaced** within a human timescale.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Fossil fuels, minerals and metals are all examples of finite resources.
cards.back_md:
**True.**

They exist in **limited amounts** and **cannot be replaced** within a human timescale.

front_blocks.md: Define **depletion**.

back_blocks.md: **Depletion** is the **reduction or exhaustion** of the available supply of a resource.

cards.front_md: Define **depletion**.
cards.back_md: **Depletion** is the **reduction or exhaustion** of the available supply of a resource.

front_blocks.md: Which two problems does careful use of **finite resources** help reduce?

back_blocks.md: Careful use of finite resources helps reduce **environmental damage** and **resource shortages**.

cards.front_md: Which two problems does careful use of **finite resources** help reduce?
cards.back_md: Careful use of finite resources helps reduce **environmental damage** and **resource shortages**.

front_blocks.md: Define **sustainable resource management**.

back_blocks.md: **Sustainable resource management** meets the **needs of the present generation** without stopping **future generations** from meeting their own needs.

cards.front_md: Define **sustainable resource management**.
cards.back_md: **Sustainable resource management** meets the **needs of the present generation** without stopping **future generations** from meeting their own needs.

front_blocks.md: Sustainable resource management helps maintain a <u>        </u> between economic growth and environmental protection.

back_blocks.md: Sustainable resource management helps maintain a **balance** between economic growth and environmental protection.

cards.front_md: Sustainable resource management helps maintain a <u>        </u> between economic growth and environmental protection.
cards.back_md: Sustainable resource management helps maintain a **balance** between economic growth and environmental protection.

front_blocks.md: Which two practices does **sustainable resource management** encourage to cut **waste**?

back_blocks.md: Sustainable resource management encourages **reuse** and **recycling** to cut waste.

cards.front_md: Which two practices does **sustainable resource management** encourage to cut **waste**?
cards.back_md: Sustainable resource management encourages **reuse** and **recycling** to cut waste.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Sustainable resource management favours short-term gain over long-term planning.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
It encourages **long-term planning** rather than short-term gain.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Sustainable resource management favours short-term gain over long-term planning.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

It encourages **long-term planning** rather than short-term gain.

front_blocks.md: What two things does **sustainable resource management** include developing?

back_blocks.md: Sustainable resource management includes developing **alternative materials** and **renewable resources**.

cards.front_md: What two things does **sustainable resource management** include developing?
cards.back_md: Sustainable resource management includes developing **alternative materials** and **renewable resources**.

front_blocks.md: Define **reuse**.

back_blocks.md: **Reuse** means using rock, ore or mineral materials **again** instead of throwing them away.

cards.front_md: Define **reuse**.
cards.back_md: **Reuse** means using rock, ore or mineral materials **again** instead of throwing them away.

front_blocks.md: How can manufacturers **reduce** the metal used in **packaging**?

back_blocks.md: Manufacturers can make **thinner metal packaging**, such as cans that use less aluminium or steel.

cards.front_md: How can manufacturers **reduce** the metal used in **packaging**?
cards.back_md: Manufacturers can make **thinner metal packaging**, such as cans that use less aluminium or steel.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Recycling aluminium drink cans uses more energy than extracting new aluminium from ore.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Recycling aluminium uses only a **small fraction of the energy** needed to extract new metal from ore.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

cards.back_md:
**False.**

Recycling aluminium uses only a **small fraction of the energy** needed to extract new metal from ore.

front_blocks.md: Which three factors encourage people to **recycle** mineral-based materials?

back_blocks.md: **Accessibility**, **ease** and **education** all encourage people to recycle.

cards.front_md: Which three factors encourage people to **recycle** mineral-based materials?
cards.back_md: **Accessibility**, **ease** and **education** all encourage people to recycle.

front_blocks.md: Define **efficient extraction**.

back_blocks.md: **Efficient extraction** means getting **more useful material** from each tonne of ore or rock.

cards.front_md: Define **efficient extraction**.
cards.back_md: **Efficient extraction** means getting **more useful material** from each tonne of ore or rock.

front_blocks.md: Which ores can improved **processing techniques** make worth mining?

back_blocks.md: Improved processing techniques can recover more copper from **low-grade ores** that were once too poor to mine.

cards.front_md: Which ores can improved **processing techniques** make worth mining?
cards.back_md: Improved processing techniques can recover more copper from **low-grade ores** that were once too poor to mine.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
More efficient extraction methods mean that more mines are needed.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Efficient methods mean **fewer mines** can produce the same amount of material.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

More efficient extraction methods mean that more mines are needed.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

Efficient methods mean **fewer mines** can produce the same amount of material.

front_blocks.md: Define **resource depletion**.

back_blocks.md: **Resource depletion** happens when people **use up** rocks, ores or minerals **faster** than they can be replaced.

cards.front_md: Define **resource depletion**.
cards.back_md: **Resource depletion** happens when people **use up** rocks, ores or minerals **faster** than they can be replaced.

front_blocks.md: Define **legislation**.

back_blocks.md: **Legislation** is the set of **laws** that control **how and where** mining and quarrying take place.

cards.front_md: Define **legislation**.
cards.back_md: **Legislation** is the set of **laws** that control **how and where** mining and quarrying take place.

front_blocks.md: What limit can governments set to slow **resource depletion**?

back_blocks.md: Governments can limit **how much ore or rock** companies extract each year.

cards.front_md: What limit can governments set to slow **resource depletion**?
cards.back_md: Governments can limit **how much ore or rock** companies extract each year.

front_blocks.md: What can laws require after **quarrying** ends?

back_blocks.md: Laws can require **land restoration**, such as replanting trees or filling open pits.

cards.front_md: What can laws require after **quarrying** ends?
cards.back_md: Laws can require **land restoration**, such as replanting trees or filling open pits.

back_blocks.md: Authorities can use **fines** or **closure orders** when mining companies break the rules.

front_blocks.md: Define **alternative materials**.

back_blocks.md: **Alternative materials** are other substances used **instead of minerals** from rocks and ores.

back_blocks.md: **Plastics** or **composites** can sometimes replace metal in these products.

cards.front_md: Which materials can sometimes replace metal in **pipes**, **window frames** or **car panels**?

Manufacturers can make concrete substitutes from industrial waste.
